scope.description: One exact published AIM Defence refresh covering current legal identity, Canadian engineering presence, Fractl capability, trials, program participation, funding and readiness boundaries.

source.title: IDEaS Counter-Uncrewed Aerial Systems Sandbox 2024

source.summary: DND records AIM Defence's Fractl:1 Tactical CUAS as a defeat-only participant, reports tracking and neutralization to 1.5 kilometres and more than 30 engagements, and awards the C$1 million first-place prize.

leads.evidenceLocator: DND 2024 AIM row and prize section; DND 2026 participant row; Mission Syracuse award and transcript; corporate registries
followUpQuestions: Which legal entity contracts for Fractl in Canada?
Which current Fractl configuration and accepted performance envelope should a buyer evaluate?
Which Mission Syracuse milestones precede a LAND 156 procurement decision?
reviewWarnings: The public AIM Defence brand spans Australian, Canadian and UK entities, but reviewed filings do not establish the legal parent-subsidiary chain or which entity holds Fractl IP, contracts and Canadian staff.

Australia's AIM DEFENCE business-name registration ended August 9, 2026 while the website remained active; current Canadian AIM Defence Inc. is corporation 1782284-7 and the former Canadian namesake is now AIM Kernel Inc.

Public Fractl labels and specifications vary by date and configuration: Fractl:1, Tactical, Civil, less than 100 versus less than 120 kilograms, and demonstrated or reported engagement ranges from 500 metres to 1.5 kilometres.

The 2024 Canadian and Australian trials support bounded prototype performance; they do not establish universal range, weather performance, certified swarm defeat, formal acceptance, operational fielding or combat use.

Mission Syracuse funds production, integration and demonstration toward combat readiness; Australian officials explicitly reserve later LAND 156 procurement and entry into service for a separate program decision.
The 2026 Canadian Counter-UAS Sandbox is scheduled for September 14 to October 9, 2026 and has not begun; no result, prize, procurement consequence or completed integration can yet be claimed.
AIM's operationally proven and sold-on-three-continents language is not supported by disclosed customer names, quantities, acceptance dates or operational-use records in the reviewed sources.
Exact laser power, sensor suite, C2 protocols, weather limits, crew, battery capacity, sustainment, production rate, current lead time and Canadian manufacturing scope remain undisclosed.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Confirmed the current Fractl offer, Tactical and Civil labels, claimed performance and global footprint while retaining company-claim attribution.
Resolved the current Canadian AIM Defence Inc. and two related corporations but not the cross-border parent-subsidiary chain.
Confirmed the 2024 Canadian trial, C$1 million prize, 1.5-kilometre event result and more than 30 engagements.
Confirmed the observed 500-metre Australian hard kill, remote operation and power constraint while separating company-attributed longer-range figures.
Confirmed A$21.3 million Mission Syracuse funding for Fractl capability, combat readiness and future LAND 156 integration.
Reconciled two GST-inclusive AusTender notices to the rounded A$21.3 million Mission Syracuse announcement without double counting.
Confirmed the government-hosted supplier subsystem, power, remote-operation and made-to-order profile while preserving its supplier-submitted posture.
Exact AIM and Fractl searches did not resolve a public patent-assignee record that would change the capability or ownership fields.
The French Canadian program surface added no different AIM entity, performance, result or procurement fact beyond the English DND record.
The final official-site and broad technical sweep found no public Fractl datasheet, interface-control document, environmental qualification, customer acceptance or separate Civil specification.

leads.refreshSummary: AIM Defence merits an ownership, current activity, operating context, capability maturity, program participation and funding-event refresh because DND's 2024 Fractl results, July 2026 selection, Mission Syracuse award and current Canadian corporate records materially replace the generic Vancouver profile.
